scripts.plugin:build: bun build packages/mcp/src/server.ts --target=bun --outfile adapters/official/claude/mcp-server.bundle.js && bun build packages/mcp/src/server.ts --target=bun --outfile adapters/official/codex/mcp-server.bundle.js && cp packages/mcp/openroly-mcp adapters/official/claude/openroly-mcp && cp packages/mcp/openroly-mcp adapters/official/codex/openroly-mcp && chmod +x adapters/official/claude/openroly-mcp adapters/official/codex/openroly-mcp
scripts.typecheck: for p in packages/core packages/crypto-envelope packages/adapter packages/mcp-mask packages/mcp adapters/official/claude adapters/official/codex adapters/official/gemini apps/server apps/cli apps/web; do [ -d "$p" ] || continue; tsc --noEmit -p "$p" || exit 1; done
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && PATH="/usr/local/opt/rustup/bin:$PATH" cargo test --manifest-path broker/Cargo.toml --quiet && sh -c '[ -f ./diagrams-check.sh ] || exit 0; ./diagrams-check.sh'
